label: Nokia G-010S-P GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT built into an SFP module (Lantiq PEB98035, OpenWrt, SC/APC BOSA) that presents itself to the host router as an HSGMII/SGMII Ethernet interface at 1 Gbit/s or 2.5 Gbit/s; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up with no LAN ports, no Wi-Fi, managed over its own web UI, SSH or telnet.
